item.title: CVE-2026-132270 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, AutoPilot prices block calls using model-supplied input but executes them with the server-resolved credential. Supplying a syntactically valid placeholder credential causes the price rule to evaluate to zero, skipping both the balance check and debit while still running paid blocks on the operator's credential. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-133448 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.1 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.7.1 through 0.8.4, chat and prompt text passed to the Claude Code CLI is pre-processed before reaching the model, bypassing AutoPilot's tool allow-list and PreToolUse hooks. In both AutoPilot's Claude Agent SDK path and the graph orchestrator block's extended_thinking SDK mode, messages starting with / execute CLI commands or bundled skills, while @<path> mentions read files or list directories on the host and attach the results to the model request. Signed-in users, members of linked chat channels, graph authors, or indirect tool output carried into turn history can make the CLI read files accessible to the copilot executor process, whose contents reach the model provider and can be repeated in replies, and run commands that compact or clear the session, switch the model, or modify the CLI's settings.json file. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-135684 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | SparkyFitness before 1.12.0 contains a missing ownership check in getNutritionixHeaders that allows authenticated users to use another user's Nutritionix API credentials via the providerId parameter. Attackers who know a victim's provider UUID can call the Nutritionix search, nutrients, item, or exercise endpoints to consume the victim's paid API quota.

item.title: CVE-2026-135685 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | SparkyFitness before 1.12.0 contains a weak password change vulnerability that allows attackers with a victim's session to change the account password without supplying the current password. Attackers can send a POST request with only newPassword to /api/identity/update-password to lock out the legitimate owner and retain persistent access.

item.title: CVE-2026-135686 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | Trilium through 0.107.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in updateNormalEntity() that allows malicious sync partners to inject SQL by supplying crafted entity names and column keys. Attackers can abuse /api/sync/changed or PUT /api/sync/update data to copy sessions, etapi_tokens and user_data into synced rows and write arbitrary database rows.

item.title: CVE-2026-135687 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Arcane before 3.0.0 fails to enforce the requiresPasswordChange account flag on the server, allowing attackers with initial or temporary credentials to obtain fully privileged access tokens. Attackers can log in via /api/auth/login and call privileged endpoints such as POST /api/users to create users without completing the mandated password change.

item.title: CVE-2026-135688 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Idno through 1.6.4 contains an unauthenticated blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in the /webmention/ endpoint that fetches attacker-supplied source URLs without scheme, host, or IP validation. Attackers can set target to a local page and source to loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata addresses, then infer internal service reachability from response status and timing.

item.title: CVE-2026-135689 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Community Store for Concrete CMS before 2.8.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via the order email in single_pages/dashboard/store/orders.php. Attackers can place guest orders with quoted email local parts containing markup to execute script in a store manager's session when viewing the order.

item.title: CVE-2026-135690 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | CivetWeb through 1.16 built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in hpack_decode() in src/http2.inl. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a crafted HEADERS frame ending with a Huffman-coded string over TLS-negotiated HTTP/2 to read one byte past the heap frame buffer.

item.title: CVE-2026-135691 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Open5GS WebUI through 2.8.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in webui/server/routes/db.js that allows authenticated user-role accounts to modify the Account model. Attackers can send PATCH /api/db/Account/<username> setting roles to admin, overwrite password hashes, delete accounts, and read hashes to gain full administrative control.

item.title: CVE-2026-135692 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a PHP object injection vulnerability in app/Casts/EncryptStringCast.php that unserializes decrypted attributes without class restrictions. Authenticated attackers can store a serialized gadget chain in encrypted fields like device passwords, triggering command execution as the web server user when read via GET /api/devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-135693 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Config Search View Matches dialog, which renders configuration context via v-html without escaping. Attackers can place markup in device banners, interface descriptions, ACL remarks or SNMP locations to execute script in a user's session and read stored configurations containing secrets.

item.title: CVE-2026-135694 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | rConfig Core 8.1.0 before 8.2.20 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in ExportController.php that allows authenticated users to export restricted tables. Attackers can supply excluded table names to export($table), bypassing the EXCLUDED_TABLES deny list, and obtain decrypted passwords, device credentials, and API tokens.

item.title: CVE-2026-135695 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.13 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the users API that allows authenticated users to modify other accounts. Attackers can send a UserController::update request with an administrator's user id and new password, then log in as that administrator to take full control.

item.title: CVE-2026-135696 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | rConfig Core 8.2.19 before 8.2.22 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass the DeviceIpIsValid loopback guard by supplying unresolved hostnames. Attackers can create a device with a hostname resolving to loopback and device_port_override 6379, causing configuration downloads to send Redis inline commands for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-135697 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Tuesday 24 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | CleverReach WP before 1.5.28 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Article_Search controller that allows unauthenticated attackers to read non-public posts by supplying post IDs. Attackers can enumerate the id parameter in search requests to retrieve raw content of draft, pending, private, and password-protected posts and pages.
